assumptions: A/B/C in external memory are zero-padded packed matrices aligned to 16 elements.
INT32 C is exported; requantization, bias and nonlinear operators are excluded.
Bank allocator: A uses bank 0/1 ping-pong; retained B spans bank 2/3, or B uses bank 2/3 ping-pong.
Single-port scratchpad banks are exclusive; accumulator has separate read/write resources.
Output groups on each chiplet are serialized; K-panel DMA may overlap execution in distinct banks.
Cycle formula adds analytical preload, array fill/drain and local service; needs RTL calibration.
External channel is shared by reads/writes; no implicit DRAM cache or multicast.
Mesh is a project extension. Gemmini itself is not a chiplet architecture.

provenance.clock_hz: No implementation clock is inferred from defaultConfig. Reports use cycles until an explicit scenario clock is supplied.
provenance.dram: One shared external channel attached to chiplet c0; finite bandwidth and capacity; scenario values, not a measured DRAM device.
provenance.mesh: Project extension: rectangular compute-only mesh, deterministic XY routing and atomic directed-path reservations. Not present in Gemmini RTL.
provenance.ppa: Area, average power and energy remain unavailable; missing calibration blocks formal PPA scoring.
